test_eval_statements: test the pybind11 eval module to execute Python statements and capture stdout output
test_eval_file: test the pybind11 eval module to evaluate and execute a Python file by filename
test_eval_empty_globals: test the pybind11 eval module to verify __builtins__ injection into empty globals dictionaries
test_eval_closure: test the pybind11 eval module to verify closure scope separation between global and local namespaces
test_eval_single_statement: test the pybind11 eval module to evaluate a single Python statement and assert success
